messages:
Maria (CS): Hey team, Eldora is aiming to flip their Dedicated pool to prod next Tue. Need alignment on quota, autoscale policy, and a runbook for intentional failures (chaos tests). Can we sync on owners and timeline?
Liam (SRE): Thanks Maria. Quick checks: what quota size are they expecting initially? and what's their target p95 latency SLA?
Eldora Ops: Planning for steady-state ~6 A100s, burst to 9 for peak. SLA target is p95 < 220ms for text-gen requests.
Arjun (Platform): OK — initial pool of 6 A100s looks fine. For autoscale I propose: min=4, desired=6, max=10 with scale-up on 75% queue length and scale-down after 5m idle. Sample policy: ```{
  "min":4,
  "desired":6,
  "max":10,
  "scale_up_trigger_pct":75,
  "scale_down_cooldown_mins":5
}```
Sofia (Solutions): We'll need a load profile to validate that — I'd run a 3-phase test: ramp, soak (30m), and spike+chaos (fail one GPU, simulate AZ loss).
Maria (CS): Can we schedule that for Thu EOD so we have Friday to address any fallout? Eldora wants a go/no-go review Mon.
Liam (SRE): Thu EOD works. I can run the soak and then do controlled failure injection. For failure injection plan: remove one node from the pool, then throttle network on another for 2 min — verify traffic routes to remaining nodes and fallback model variant kicks in if needed.
Eldora Ops: Good. Also want a cost estimate for bursting to 10 for 30m during spikes so procurement can approve.
Arjun (Platform): I'll produce a quick estimate: bursting to 10 A100s for 30m ~ ~X USD (I'll post exact after checking current region rates). Also confirm cache warming steps so latency doesn't spike on first requests.
Sofia (Solutions): On cache: run prefix warmup using their top-50 prompts. I'll provide the prompt list and warmup script. Suggest adding a metric check: "cache_hit_rate" > 70% after warmup.
Maria (CS): Action items: 1) Arjun: cost numbers + confirm autoscale policy by Wed EOD. 2) Liam: run Thu EOD soak + chaos, produce postmortem checklist. 3) Sofia: warmup script + prompt list. 4) Eldora Ops: confirm exact top-50 prompt set by Wed. I'll coordinate the Monday go/no-go review.
Liam (SRE): Noted. I'll also add an alert to the runbook: if p95 > 400ms for 5m during soak, abort and scale up to max, hold, then investigate.
deploy-bot: loadtest job scheduled: job_id=lt-20260325-eldora-01, start=2026-03-25T21:00Z, profile=ramp-soak-spike
Eldora Ops: Thanks — we'll get the prompt list over by EOD Wed. One ask: can we run an additional test that simulates degraded KV cache (cold start) so we can see worst-case latency?
Sofia (Solutions): Yes — include a cold-cache run in the ramp phase. We'll mark it as 'cold-cache-check' and record spike latency separately.
Maria (CS): Perfect. I'll put this summary into the Eldora onboarding doc and send calendar invites. Thanks everyone :rocket:
